decisions.reason: The client explicitly preserves the same net giveaway amount; the source changes draw size and frequency, not per-sale revenue allocation.
Changing prize winner counts and draw frequencies does not alter the $5 coded-referral commission.
The source changes prize amounts and draw frequencies but does not decide whether prizes use automatic delivery or a claim flow.
The source does not change the secondary royalty amount, its allocation, its pool-funding behavior, or whether secondary sales generate tickets.
The block-prize adjustment does not change the $15 primary mint price.
The source changes prize draw parameters but does not alter how books, referral codes, badges, or ticket state transfer with an NFT.
Message 158 does not remove or modify Aave yield integration; any later statement about Aave requires its own source Event.
The prize adjustment does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited primary-mint supply model.
Both Small Block and Big Block ticket counters remain required; the source changes draw parameters rather than metadata counter presence.
